question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the highlighted group of words in the given sentence.

The tailor was called to stitch the __long loose gowns worn by priests and choristers__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Cassocks**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cassocks"** refers to long, loose gowns worn by priests or choristers, often as part of religious or ceremonial dress. (कासॉक - पादरियों या गायक मंडलियों द्वारा पहने जाने वाले लंबे ढीले वस्त्र)

 
 
• **Example: **The priest adjusted his cassock before the service began.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct one-word substitution for "long loose gowns worn by priests and choristers" is **"cassocks"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 - Cassocks**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Frocks **(फ्रॉक): A woman's or girl's dress.

 
 
• **Example:** Little girls often wear frocks with floral designs.
 
 
 
• **Petticoats **(पेटीकोट): An underskirt worn under a dress or skirt.
 
 
• **Example:** The petticoat added volume to her traditional lehenga.
 
 
 
• **Tuxedos **(टक्सीडो): A formal evening suit for men.
 
 
• **Example:** The host of the gala wore a sharp tuxedo.
